name: folio
description: Folio, a CommonMark Markdown renderer and static-site generator in Lean, compiled to WebAssembly by Lasm, with proofs

scripts.test:wasi: node test/cli.mjs --engine node --engine wasmtime --engine wasmer --engine node-wasi
scripts.build:server: npm run build:preview && lasm build PreviewServer.lean --output dist/server
scripts.build:bun: npm run build:preview && bunx --bun lasm build PreviewServer.lean --target bun
scripts.build:deno: npm run build:preview && lasm build PreviewServer.lean --target deno
